**Finding submitted: MISSING (insurance clause absent).**

- **Investigation:** Full-text searches for "insur", "insured", "certificate of insurance", "workers compensation", and "errors and omissions" returned only (i) asset-specific cover — replacement-value insurance on consigned Products with IBM as joint insured (§13.1, p0909) and joint insured status on IBM-owned tooling (§21.2, p1107); (ii) freight/shipment insurance as a cost item (§10.5, §21.1); and (iii) unrelated uses of "insure" meaning "ensure". The §9.0 workers' compensation reference is an IBM-side pre-closing employment liability, not an MSL insurance covenant. The section outline confirms no insurance article exists in the General article (§16) or elsewhere.
- **Assessment:** MSL performs at leased IBM premises, handles IBM inventory and holds IBM I/T system/data access, so the complete absence of CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation cover falls into walk-away territory and fails both checklist levels.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` at the end of the General article (new §16.22) carrying only the six preferred elements — no survival tail, no at-own-expense or procedural boilerplate. The cyber trigger is drafted broadly ("any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for IBM") rather than narrowed to named examples, and the comment offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M). Redline validated `ok:true` with the minimality gate clean.
